newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks quiet, Daugavpils dips, RTF higher.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks quiet, Daugavpils dips, RTF higher.

text.p: Latvian stock volume slipped on Friday but prices mostly advanced, dealers said.
Riga Transport Fleet recovered after sinking yesterday while Daugavpils Chain dropped in what was seen as a surprise fall in price, dealers said.
Total turnover was 133,000 lats versus 167,000 lats and the Rietumu index rose 1.2 percent to 198.53.
Daugavpils Chain fell to 2.40 lats from 2.79 lats or 14 percent in a move which surprised many market-watchers. Daugavpils traded 69,500 lats of shares.
"This came as a surprise and foreign investors were seen selling," one dealer said.
Riga Transport Fleet, an official list stock, almost fully regained the ground it lost yesterday on volume of 10,900 lats.
Fleet closed at 1.62 lats or 14 percent up.
Leading bank Unibanka remained stable at 3.80 on volume of 22,400 lats and fellow official list share Staburadze confectionery was down nine santimes to 2.61 lats on a small volume of 400 shares.

Kaija, which today said would submit its official list prospectus after April 20, continued climbing for the fourth consecutive day. The cannery traded 11,500 lats and added two santimes to 2.52 lats.
Among other blue chips, Valmiera Glassfibre was also in demand as it traded 5,700 lats of shares and rose two santimes to 1.84 lats.
Lode Brick was among the day's losers as it fell to 2.45 lats from 2.59 lats on tiny volume of 200 lats of shares.
